headline: CII Exporter: Duty and tax remission scheme supports exports, helpful in challenging global environment - dainiktribuneonline.com
summary: The CII exporters' body says extending the Remission of Duties and Taxes on Exported Products scheme to December 31 is important for exporters in a challenging global environment.
why: RoDTEP refunds embedded duties and taxes on exports, so its extension affects the cost competitiveness of Indian exporters.
